summary: Describes using the Camellia block cipher in CBC, CTR and CCM modes as additional, optional-to-implement mechanisms for IKEv2 and ESP in IPsec. They provide confidentiality and, in the case of CCM, integrity.

eli5.summary: IPsec locks internet traffic, and this note adds another lock called Camellia as an optional choice, with several ways to use it.

questions: how to use camellia with ipsec
